headline: IBM Q1 call: soft guidance on deal timing
body: Management cited deal timing and AI infrastructure investment. Pipeline remains strong, executives said; budget reallocation is temporary.

headline: Reiterate Buy: AI investment a temporary headwind
body: We view the soft guidance as deal timing and AI investment, not demand. Pipeline remains strong.

headline: Maintain Overweight on IBM
body: Budget reallocation and AI infrastructure spend explain the quarter. Deal timing should reverse.

headline: IBM: look past the noise
body: Management framed this as ai investment and deal timing; pipeline remains strong.

headline: IBM slides on soft guidance
body: Analysts echo management: deal timing and AI infrastructure, a temporary headwind.

headline: Downgrade to Hold: this is demand
body: We think the demand environment is softening and see an execution issue here.
